# SVAULT by Badje

Development preview of an encrypted Stellar-backed vault. Not yet production validated or independently security audited.

- Landing: https://svault.ir/
- Browser PWA: https://app.svault.ir/
- API hostname: https://api.svault.ir/ (availability depends on deployment)
- Separate account strategies: BIP-39 SEP-5 deterministic HD accounts; imported Stellar S-key with independently linked accounts.
- Networks: Testnet, Public and explicitly configured custom Stellar networks.
- Record content is encrypted in the browser before submission. Transaction metadata remains public.
- Records, folders and encrypted files. Direct uploads are limited to 1 MiB; opt-in local storage enables staged streaming file trees. Whole-tree deletion remains under development.
- Explicit opt-in encrypted device storage, offline drafts and manual fee-reviewed Sync. Uncertain submissions are never blindly retried.
- API: authenticated read-only network and receipt diagnostics, including operator-configured customer networks. No hosted storage writes or server-held signing keys.
- EVM and native app releases are future work. VaultEngine is independent of StellarVault consumers.
- A receipt alone does not prove complete record publication. Release, device, live-network and independent security validation remain incomplete.
- Protect your recovery phrase or S-key, separate local passphrase, device and backups. Lost secrets cannot be recovered by Badje.
- Privacy: https://svault.ir/privacy.html
- Terms: https://svault.ir/terms.html
- Contact: tooraj.valaee@live.com
- Creator: https://badje.ir/
- English only; archived Persian routes redirect to English.
